batch_commitment.encoding: canonical length-prefixed big-endian encoding defined by consensus/systemcall

transport.authentication: same JWT-authenticated private Engine API boundary
transport.required_order: stage batch before payload construction and before NewPayload validation

bond_authority: Bond composition changes are custody-driven by register/topUpOwnedBond/replaceProtocolCredit and slash/withdrawal value flows; consensus has no accounting-only bond setter.
execution_client_requirements: Reuse go-ethereum SystemAddress only through native block-processing system-call machinery.
System calls must execute as EVM messages inside block state transition.
System calls must not appear in the user transaction trie.
Execution header extraData must equal the committed system-call batch root.
Consensus and execution must enforce identical batch-size limits before EVM execution.
System-call failure invalidates the candidate payload atomically.
No public JSON-RPC method may synthesize the privileged gateway call.
Gateway and downstream state changes must be included in the execution state root.
